content.short: Erigon is a fast, memory-optimized Ethereum execution client written in Go.
content.description: Erigon is a fast, memory-optimized Ethereum execution client written in Go. It started as a fork of Go Ethereum with the goal of a quicker Go-based execution client and improved disk efficiency. Today, Erigon provides a high-performance Ethereum implementation and makes it feasible to run full Ethereum archival nodes using about 3 TB of disk space. It is the second most popular Ethereum execution client, accounting for roughly 7% of the ecosystem.
